desc: The 1x30mm ProPoint comes with a Picatinny mount and comes with an optional high-rise adapter to open up the mounting possibilities and making it perfect for Modern Sporting Rifles (MSR) and Pistol Caliber Carbines (PCC) as well as shotguns. The daylight bright 3 MOA dot is crisp and clear and pairs up perfectly with the multi-coated lenses for brilliant imaging with no off-color tinting found in many optics. This provides a clear view of the target and aiming point for fast and accurate aiming. Brightness is controlled by by dial through 6 different brightness settings, and we gave it off positions between each setting for quickly returning to your favorite brightness level.
